newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Vietnam becomes eighth member of rubber group.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam becomes eighth member of rubber group.

text.p: - Vietnam has become the eighth member of the Association of Natural Rubber Producing Countries (ANRPC), the group said on Tuesday.

The ANRPC member countries now account for 85 percent of world output of natural rubber, Malaysia's national news agency Bernama quoted ANRPC secretary general J. Lalithambika as saying in a statement.
Vietnam, which contributed close to two percent of world rubber production in 1995, deposited its Instrument of Accession to the ANRPC Constitution with the Malaysian government on Oct 10, he said.
The ANRPC now groups India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Vietnam.
Vietnam could take advantage of technical cooperation programmes and other activities of the association, Lalithambika said.
